scope: Two ideal one-mode charge-insensitive transmon circuit benchmarks, no EM extraction
rationale: Koch 2007 Sec II.B gives exponential suppression of charge dispersion with EJ/EC. New ratios 200 and 250 target that approximation; prior ratio 66.7 discrepancy remains rejected as an exact ng=0 comparison.
tolerance_rationale: One Hz absolute numerical resolution per representation; two Hz conservative combined numerical discrepancy budget, conditional on <=1 Hz charge spread. These are predeclared numerical benchmark requirements, not a measurement accuracy claim or a tolerance taken from published experimental data.
failure_policy: Retain and reject any failed condition; do not widen thresholds or adjust cases after execution.
